errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the sectors appear to be arranged in decreasing order of size. Following the sectors clockwise from the top, the percentages are approximately 4.3% (light blue), 40.5% (dark blue), 19.0% (orange), ~10% (grey), and 26.2% (yellow). This is not a decreasing or any other consistent order based on size.
